title: Practice the queen's long-range move.
goal: Capture the opposing pawn on the square d5 with your queen.
narration_seed: A queen moves in straight lines like a rook or slanting lines like a bishop.
hints: Move the queen straight upward through the empty column from the square d1 to the square d5.
solution_text: Move your queen from the square d1 to capture on the square d5.
success_text: You used your queen to capture on the square d5.
failure_text: Look up the clear vertical column from the square d1.
